transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As part of our standard launch-governance process, I need each of you to state any legal condition that must be included in the launch packet before I can give final authorization for the October 1 external release of our clinical documentation platform. Please go through your functional areas one at a time.
transcript.speaker: A1
transcript.raw_output: {"type": "say", "text": "Good morning, everyone. Please go through your functional areas one at a time."}

transcript.text: My completed license review of the production build found that module M-17 incorporates an AGPL-licensed library. Under our company's approved proprietary deployment policy, M-17 must be replaced before any external customer access. I have not yet added this result to the launch packet, and this condition must be included before final authorization for the October 1 release.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a privacy condition. In the signed design-partner agreement, I confirmed that customer content may not be used to train or improve our models and must be deleted within exactly 30 days after account termination. However, I have not yet updated the standard privacy language in the launch packet to reflect these commitments. Before final authorization for the October 1 release, the privacy template in the launch packet must be updated to include these binding restrictions on customer content use and the 30-day deletion obligation.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a regulatory condition. My intended-use review concluded that the planned language describing automated clinical triage recommendations makes diagnostic claims. The launch materials must instead describe the product as an administrative workflow tool only. I have not yet circulated that review, and this condition must be included before final authorization for the October 1 release.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to flag a commercial-contract condition. The anchor hospital's signed letter of intent permits production use only after the company provides a SOC 2 Type II report and includes an annual customer audit right in the definitive agreement. I have not yet inserted those terms into the contract draft. Before final authorization for the October 1 release, the enterprise-contract template in the launch packet must be updated to include the SOC 2 Type II report requirement and the annual customer audit right.
transcript.speaker: A5
